_about: XunPu DC-091-A250 DC power jack (LCSC C720588), right angle, through hole, 5.5 x 2.5 mm plug. Millimetres, top view, origin at the centre between the centre-pin hole and the locating hole, y up. Source: JLCPCB/LCSC EasyEDA footprint DC-IN-TH_DC-091-A250 for C720588 (easyeda.com/api/products/C720588/components, 25 Nov 2026; 10 mil units, y flipped to up). Pin numbers as the maker's schematic (datasheet.lcsc.com d518c1ac5815932daf091d84664d5ffa.pdf, XunPu drawing DC-091-A250 rev A): 3 the centre pin (round hole, 1.50 mm), 6 the sleeve on four shield legs, 4 the switch spring. Here pin1 = 3 (VIN), pin2 = 4 (SW), pins 3-6 = the four 6 legs (GND, GND_2..GND_4).
